Old draft
This one was deleted — it should only appear in Recently Deleted, and be restorable from there.

Guest note
Sign in as guest@seed.local to see this — it proves per-owner filtering: evan@seed.local must never see it.

Google sign-in
Tapping Continue with Google resolves this pre-seeded identity — the provider button is a real seeded user, not a fresh one.

Owner scoping
Only google-user@seed.local sees this folder; other sign-in methods land on their own seed keys.

Apple sign-in
Tapping Continue with Apple resolves this pre-seeded identity — same email-matching path as every other credential flow.

Owner scoping
Only apple-user@seed.local sees this folder; the Google button lands on its own seed key.

Admin runbook
Sign in as admin@seed.local to see the All users section on the Folders screen — every owner's folders with live note counts.

Visibility, not authority
Admin sees all owners' folders read-only. The fake backend has no security boundary — this is a client-side showcase of role metadata.
